unitemized.reason: This is the positive form of it-045 (parameterized queries/ORM). Checking it needs a semantic review of query code, and it-045 already covers the part that can be checked.
Heading order in frontend markup only matters for frontend work, and that condition can't be written as a predicate. Whether the order is 'proper' is also a judgement call.
A 'prefer' style guideline that only applies to CSS work. Whether a fixed-pixel value is appropriate can't be decided mechanically.
A general style guideline. The engine has no formatter or linter evidence kind, and 'consistent style' is subjective.
Naming quality comes with an exception for 'narrow contexts', so no deterministic check can tell which abbreviations are allowed.
Indentation consistency is a general style guideline. No kind checks it, and it overlaps with it-087.
Advice to configure an editor or linter is a general standard, not a required workflow action. The run can't show whether it was followed.
